I told Hollis it's 382 seats, in a thread on his message in #central-team.

That number comes from Tobias, who posted it in #central-team on Oct 14 as the seat count for Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal. Hollis is in that channel, so he could already see it, and a seat count isn't a finance figure, so sharing it was fine.

I couldn't check it against anything else because there are no Marrow Agrisupply files in the share. I suggested he confirm with Tobias if he wants to be sure before updating the account sheet.
